source.query: SELECT id, project_id, object_type, status_code, is_deleted, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updated_at, DATE_FORMAT(actual_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS actual_start, DATE_FORMAT(actual_end, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS actual_end, '__BATCH__' AS batch_id FROM story WHERE updated_at > '__CURSOR__' AND updated_at <= '__UPPER__' ORDER BY updated_at, id
